# Assessment Overview

This document is a navigation entry point for the supplementary assessment documents generated for the **Spring HATEOAS Examples** project.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer architecture visualization: high-level application architecture and component relationship diagram for the multi-module Spring Boot application |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category, including version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Full inventory of REST API endpoints, service catalog, communication patterns, DTOs, and service technology matrix |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, JPA entity model ER diagram, repository methods, data ownership boundaries, and data sensitivity classification |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, properties inventory, startup dependencies, and framework versions |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Domain entity descriptions, primary business workflows (employee CRUD, order state machine, API evolution), business rules, and state transition documentation |
